headline: Going Commando reaches a reported 7760 of 8579 matched functions
summary: Going Commando's final progress commit reports 7760 of 8579 functions matched. These functions compile to exactly the same bytes as the original game. Merged work spans boot code, levels and the lock-on tether family, including further functions in Yeedil and Aranos prison.
highlights: A batch of 453 boot and level functions merged (#384).
Work across USA, USA v2.00 and PAL includes the lock-on tether family and two compiler fixes (#386).
Additional level work merged, including 13 functions in Yeedil and Aranos prison (#385, #387).
Another function match landed while near misses were retained for further work (#388).
A native-port backfill proposal opened but did not merge (#389).
